findings.summary: crates/server/tests/metrics.rs, access.rs: no test checks that the public router doesn't serve /metrics. With `.route("/metrics", get(metrics))` added to routes::router outside the Access layer, every server test still passes (mutations.log). Live, the public port gave 401 without a token and 404 with one.
crates/app/src/main.rs:get: no test covers sending CF-Access-Client-Id/Secret or the one-of-two check; both are in the binary. I saw both work only under Xvfb.

crates/app/src/main.rs: when Access refuses the native app (no token or a wrong secret), the app shows 'Couldn't refresh from ...: expected value at line 1 column 1'. That's the login page failing to parse as JSON, and it doesn't say that access was refused (05-app-none.png, 05-app-wrongsecret.png). It's an error, not the board. With real Cloudflare the answer would be a redirect or 403. I didn't observe that.

crates/server/src/access.rs:check: jsonwebtoken's default 60 s exp leeway applies. A token 59 s past exp got 200 and one 65 s past got 401 (leeway.log). That's probably fine, but it isn't written down, and the test's expired token is 120 s old.

deploy/values.yaml: access.issuer and access.aud are empty. CI's `helm template sdlc-board deploy` fails (exit 1, 'Missing required value'), as the ticket notes say. With them --set, `helm lint` and `helm template` (alpine/helm:3.19.0) pass. They render a NetworkPolicy, ConfigMap, Service, Deployment, HTTPRoute and ServiceMonitor. The rendered board.toml loads in the server. I didn't run kubeconform: its images and downloads are blocked here.

Only the cluster can show these, and I didn't exercise them: Cloudflare's real login and service-token policy, the tunnel and the board.trulinc.com route, the ArgoCD sync, Image Updater's write-back, the GHCR push and pull secret, the ServiceMonitor being picked up, and the NetworkPolicy letting kubelet probes, Traefik and Prometheus through. The Android build is TRU-13. Docker Hub returned 429 twice before the image build ran. The third try ran the cargo build step fresh (147.8 s).
